commits.subject: refactor(cech): reuse the object projection seam
commits.summary: Replace the unlimited-heartbeat degree-zero augmentation proof with coreIso_objIso_π and named backbone adapters, remove obsolete planner prose and no-op tactics, document the five remaining bounded proof budgets, and verify the public module warning-free.

commits.subject: docs(blueprint): record augmentation projection dependency
commits.summary: Link the degree-zero section Čech augmentation proof to the reusable coreIso_objIso_π projection lemma used by the optimized Lean proof.

commits.subject: perf(cech): assemble differentials categorically
commits.summary: Replace elementwise Čech coface and alternating-sum proofs with opaque morphism-level composition lemmas, remove all local elaboration overrides, and reduce the LegAux kernel build from over ten minutes to 16 seconds.

commits.subject: perf(cech): abstract face restriction naturality
commits.summary:
Replace the concrete variable-length intersection residual with generic open-inclusion morphisms and a small categorical map-composition lemma, reducing LegTop from a >30-minute, ~11.7 GiB non-completing baseline to a warning-free 1:20 build at 3.28 GiB.

Name the restrict-world push-pull normal form, remove two obsolete 1.6M scopes plus all transparency/synthesis overrides, and retain only documented 800k/1.6M/800k declaration-local bounds.

commits.subject: refactor(cech): trim intermediate proof budgets
commits.summary: Document the one remaining bounded normalization budget in LegMid2 and remove three stale heartbeat, transparency, and synthesis overrides after a zero-diagnostic LSP check and warning-free build.

commits.subject: refactor(cech): retire stale unlimited budgets
commits.summary: **Čech backbone.** `backboneIncl_proj` and `coreIso_objIso_π` now verify at project defaults, removing two unlimited heartbeat scopes, two transparency overrides, and one raised synthesis budget; the focused Mid1 build passes without warnings in 17.21s user CPU.

commits.subject: perf(cech): bound coface normalization
commits.summary:
**Čech coface.** Kept the public coface equality unchanged but changed its proof through `cechNerveCosimplicial`, reducing the focused Leg build from 1419s to 39.79s user CPU and removing a 1.6M-heartbeat/transparency scope.

**WPCI cleanup.** Folded four one-use private induction helpers into the single projection theorem, deleting duplicated seven-isomorphism successor signatures while preserving the public distributivity lemma.

commits.subject: fix(blueprint): canonicalize duplicate nodes and references
commits.summary: **Blueprint references.** Kept the Cech open-pullback lemma and GlueDescent endpoint bridges in their mathematical homes, removed duplicate restatements, and split 41 unsupported comma-list references into resolvable single-label links.

commits.subject: chore(AJC): record round-3 hygiene checkpoint
commits.summary: **Planning hygiene.** Confirmed the nested Jacobian roadmap remains truthful at 4/22 done, retained 11 active protection memories intentionally, and refreshed the quarantined graph counts without touching generated nodes.

commits.subject: docs(workspace): present both Jacobian routes
commits.summary: Document the ambitious Picard-scheme route and the curve-specialized Rebuild as distinct live projects, with direct navigation to the AJC proof root, final witness, blueprint, and focused roadmap.
